title: Do you do it or make it?

scene.speaker: maya
scene.bubble: English mystery: you MAKE a cake but you DO the dishes. Who invented these rules?!
scene.intro: English mystery, investigated by Maya and Ingrid: you MAKE a cake but you DO the dishes. You make your bed, you make a mistake, you make a noise. You do your homework, you do the shopping, you do your best. Why? Nobody knows — but everybody has to learn it. Ingrid writes two lists on the wall. Make or do? Choose the right one for each thing you do today!

data.script: Ingrid: Saturday chores, team! Maya, you read the list. … Maya: First: everybody makes their own bed. No exceptions, Oliver! … Maya: Diego does the dishes — there are only six plates today. … Maya: Ingrid and I do the shopping at the market. … Maya: Oliver makes lunch. Please, not pizza again… okay, pizza again. … Maya: And Kili? Kili makes everyone laugh. That's his official chore! … Ingrid: When we finish, we all make a big lemonade and rest on the balcony.
